_comment: Named MCP servers for this fork. Copy to .mcp.json and fill in. The point is the NAME: a connector declared here resolves as mcp__<name>__<tool>, which survives a re-install, a new machine, and a different account. Harness-generated ids (mcp__<uuid>__tool) do not — and when one stops matching, the tool is simply not found, the agent reports the source unavailable, and your digest renders a clean 'no signal' for a connector that was working fine. Lint rule mcp-uuid-pin refuses the pinned form.
